provenance: Independent left-hand configuration. Finger-group numbering follows the user's reported mirror of the right glove: little 1/2, ring 3/4, middle 5/6, index 7/8, thumb 9/10. Within-pair segment assignments and palm/wrist numbering retain the existing convention pending physical confirmation. Sample/output rate, scale factors and filter policy remain copied starting assumptions, not measurements of the left glove. Later right-hand changes are not inherited.
notes: Use the actual MANO_LEFT model and a new left-hand calibration; profiles made with the previous left numbering are not reusable. Odd IDs 1/3/5/7 map to long-finger middle phalanges, even IDs 2/4/6/8 to proximal phalanges; thumb 9 is distal and 10 proximal. Palm 11 and unmapped wrist 12 are retained. The group permutation does not change raw-axis signs, unit scales or the tactile layout. Sensor mounting, units and cadence still require left-device validation. Never copy right-hand calibration, functional profiles, device bindings or measured unloaded references.
